annotations.title: Wildberries price history: weekly CDN points + observed + live price, min/max/avg, 30-day change

description:
Wildberries price history: weekly CDN points + observed + live price, min/max/avg, 30-day change. Price history for a Wildberries product: weekly points from WB's public price-history CDN (weekly_cdn), prices this service observed on earlier lookups (observed; in-memory, reset on restart), and the current live price (live). Returns points (oldest first), current, stats min/max/avg, change_30d (vs. the latest point at least 30 days old) and history_limited:true with a note when only the current price exists. Ozon has no public history (only live, currently blocked). 502 (not settled) only when no price at all is available.

GET /product/history — price $0.004 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

url.description: Product page URL: https://www.wildberries.ru/catalog/<id>/detail.aspx (also wb.ru, *.wildberries.ru) or https://www.ozon.ru/product/<slug>-<id>/ (also *.ozon.ru)
